title: Insulin Pump Program Fulfillment Quantity Standard: Pumps and Supplies
content:
## The pump

The pump itself (E0784) ships on an Insulin Pump Program as one billing unit, once per program, signed for on delivery; a second pump ships on the same program only as a manufacturer warranty exchange or as a new pump under the replacement interval below.

A payer covers a new pump only once the tier's payer replacement interval in calendar months has passed since the delivery date of the pump originally supplied on the program, counted in calendar months from that delivery date with the same calendar day allowed (the last day of the month when that day does not exist). An earlier new pump is supplied only at the pump cash price for its model under the advance-notice-of-liability rules, and on the self-pay tier every pump is sold at that price.

A new (not warranty-exchanged) pump is written onto the program by a program change that records its model, serial number and delivery date; a warranty exchange changes only the serial number.

| Hypothetical case (48-month interval, original pump delivered on the 15th of a month) | Payer covers a new pump |
|---|---|
| On the 15th of the month 48 months later | Yes — the same calendar day is allowed |
| On the 14th of that month | No — only at the cash price under a signed notice |

## Supplies by pump model

Supply refills follow the pump model on the program:

- **Infusion catheter supplies (A4224)** ship one billing unit per the tier's days of supply per A4224 unit, rounded up.
- **Cartridges or reservoirs** ship as the item the model uses, at the tier's cartridges or reservoirs per 30 days for every 30 days of supply. *This cartridge clause is no longer in force for a cartridge or reservoir refill shipment, whose quantity follows its current refill rule; every other supply line of the program remains under the quantity rules of this standard.*
- **Pump-integrated sensors (A4239)** ship on a MiniMed 780G program at the tier's A4239 units and physical sensors per 30 days of supply. No other model receives sensors under the pump program.

## Training and self-pay pricing

On tiers where pump training is required, supply refills ship only after a medical record documenting completed pump training is on file for the program. On the self-pay tier supplies are charged at the cash price per billing unit of each item.

*Hypothetical example:* a 90-day infusion-set shipment at 7 days per unit is 13 A4224 units (12.86 rounded up).
